# What DS we need

  - one reference of in-vivo Colon vs.  Stomach
  - one reference of in-vivo IM vs. healthy / non-IM
  - Organoids +WR colon vs.Stomach (van Wetering + Bartfeld / Kayisoglu)
  - ex-vivo  IM vs. non-IM 
  - ex-vivo IM vs. healthy stomach
  - Marker genes of scRNA IM + healthy gut (SI, LI, stomach)

# Mean and median signature log2FC


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
all_ovlp = list()
sel_ds = names(all_ds)
fc_threshold = 0.5
adj_p_threshold = 0.1

all_mean_lfc <- list()
all_median_lfc <- list()
all_huberM <- list()
all_wins_mean_lfc <- list()

for (n in sel_ds) {
  tmp = all_ds[[n]]
  
  comps <- names(tmp$dge)
  
  for (cc in comps) {
    tmp2 <- tmp$dge[[cc]]
    
    if("logFC" %in% colnames(tmp2)) {
      #DESeq2
      lfc_col <- "logFC"
      if("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(tmp2)) {
        gs_col = "SYMBOL"
      } else {
        gs_col = "Gene Symbol"
      }
    } else {
      #LIMMA
      lfc_col <- "log2FoldChange"
      gs_col = "GeneSymbol"
    }

    for (gs in names(sc_sets)) {
      set_genes = sc_sets[[gs]]
      set_gene_agg_lfc <- tmp2[match(set_genes, tmp2[[gs_col]]), lfc_col ]
      
      all_mean_lfc[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___",gs)]] = mean(set_gene_agg_lfc, na.rm=T)
      all_median_lfc[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___",gs)]] = median(set_gene_agg_lfc, na.rm=T)
      all_huberM[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___",gs)]] = huberM(set_gene_agg_lfc)$mu
      all_wins_mean_lfc[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___",gs)]] = mean(set_gene_agg_lfc, na.rm = T, trim = 0.025)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
lfc_res <- all_mean_lfc

tmp <- strsplit(names(lfc_res), "___")
res_desc <- data.frame(id = names(lfc_res), 
                       ds = sapply(tmp, `[`, 1), 
                       comp = sapply(tmp, `[`, 2),
                       celltype = sapply(tmp, `[`, 3) |> gsub("UP_", "", x=_)
                       )
res_desc$label <- paste0(res_desc$ds, "_", res_desc$comp)
res_desc$mean_lfc <- all_mean_lfc[res_desc$id] |> unlist()
res_desc$median_lfc <- all_median_lfc[res_desc$id] |> unlist()
res_desc$huberM_lfc <- all_huberM[res_desc$id] |> unlist()
res_desc$wins_mean_lfc <- all_wins_mean_lfc[res_desc$id] |> unlist()

res_desc$ds_type <- ds_to_type[res_desc$ds]

```

```{r, fig.width=24}
res_desc$ds_type <- factor(res_desc$ds_type, levels=group_levels)
#ggplot(res_desc, aes(x=ds_type, fill=label, y=huberM_lfc)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", position = position_dodge()) + facet_wrap(~celltype, scales="free_y")

ggplot(res_desc, aes(x=ds_type, col=label, y=huberM_lfc)) + 
  geom_point(size=3) + 
  stat_summary(aes(group=ds_type), fun.data = function(x) mean_se(x, mult = 2), size=1) + 
  facet_wrap(~celltype, scales="free_y") + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("IM ex vivo","IM"), c("IM ex vivo","SI ex vivo"), c("IM ex vivo","LI ex vivo"),c("SI ex vivo","IM"),c("LI ex vivo","IM")), method = "t.test")


ggplot(res_desc, aes(x=ds_type, col=label, y=wins_mean_lfc)) + 
  geom_point(size=3) + 
  stat_summary(aes(group=ds_type), fun.data = function(x) mean_se(x, mult = 2), size=1) + 
  facet_wrap(~celltype, scales="free_y") + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("IM ex vivo","IM"), c("IM ex vivo","SI ex vivo"), c("IM ex vivo","LI ex vivo"),c("SI ex vivo","IM"),c("LI ex vivo","IM")), method = "t.test") + 
  labs(x="", y="Winsorized Mean log2FC vs normal stomach")

```


# Final

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
res_desc$ds_type <- factor(res_desc$ds_type, levels=group_levels)
#ggplot(res_desc, aes(x=ds_type, fill=label, y=huberM_lfc)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", position = position_dodge()) + facet_wrap(~celltype, scales="free_y")

sel_celltypes <- c("BEST4+ epithelial","Colonocyte AQP8","Enterocyte proximal","Goblet cell")
res_desc_sel <- subset(res_desc, celltype %in% sel_celltypes)
res_desc_sel$celltype <- factor(res_desc_sel$celltype, levels=sel_celltypes)

p <- ggplot(res_desc_sel, aes(x=ds_type, col=ds_type, y=wins_mean_lfc)) + 
  geom_point(size=3, col="grey50") + 
  stat_summary(aes(group=ds_type), fun.data = function(x) mean_se(x, mult = 2), size=.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~celltype, scales="free_y", ncol = 6) + 
  #scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3,5)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-.5,6)) +
  theme_bw() + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("IM ex vivo","IM"), c("IM ex vivo","SI ex vivo"),c("SI ex vivo","IM"), c("LI ex vivo","IM"), c("IM ex vivo","LI ex vivo")), method = "t.test", label.y.npc = 1) + 
  labs(x="", y="Trimmed Mean of log2FC vs Normal Stomach") + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=16), 
        legend.position = "none", 
        strip.text = element_text(size=16) ) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty=2)

print(p)
```

```{r}
pdf(file.path(result_folder, "Magnitude_of_DE_v2_sel_celltypes.pdf"), width=14, height = 6)
print(p)
dev.off()
```
